description:
Rename an alert, pause it, or both. Needs edit_revision from get_alert. To turn a paused alert back on, use quote_resume and resume_alert. Pausing stops future checks; checks already running finish and are charged.

Permission: alerts:write.

edit_revision.description: edit_revision from get_alert. The edit fails if the alert changed since.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key (16–100 letters, digits, - or _) for each request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request.

name: edit_alert
title: Rename or pause an alert
